added.derivation: PIC S9(3) DISPLAY seen through X(3), EBCDIC sign convention as characters. '12C' is +123 and stays '12C' after ADD 0. '12L' is -123 and stays '12L'. '123' (zone F) is +123 and becomes '12C' after ADD 0, because arithmetic stores the preferred sign. MOVE 0 stores '00{'. MOVE -5 stores '00N'. Exit 0, no output.

Through data items S9(09)V99 * S9(04)V99 / 1200 into S9(09)V99: 250.75 and 21.00 give 4.388125, stored 4.38; -250.75 gives -4.38; 999999999.99 and 9999.99 give 8333324999.91666675, stored 333324999.91 (decimals discarded, leading digit lost; no ROUNDED, no ON SIZE ERROR). Exit 0, no output.
